notes: Eclipse Loop 2.5.7 - one fix, and it is the one that mattered. Loop could hang on launch with no window at all: nothing to click, nothing in the Dock to answer, Force Quit the only way out. The cause was microphone permission - Loop asked macOS for the mic before it had a window, so the permission check had nowhere to appear and everything stopped behind it. Loop now opens sound output first, puts its window on screen, and only then asks about the microphone.
